method: Independent full semantic review of current immutable original bytes, including field evidence binding and conditional application requirements; read-only strict assessor; no approval-field edits.

checks.detail: Independently reread the complete official admissions body and compared identity, level, medium, exact duration, language alternatives, qualifications, all application-document conditions, current intake dates and fees. The proposed 2026-10-18 verification and 2026-10-25 review date are supported by the fresh whole-fact review, not a date-only renewal.

All raw/text bytes match the batch and HTTP200 capture receipts; source and capture URLs agree. Official university subdomains, same-host TLS acquisition, robots status and original robots byte hashes were checked. Captures are within 24 hours and not future-dated.

Read-only strict assessor against the current normalized canonical bundle reports 0 ready and 2 held per school, with independent_review_missing as the sole blocker for each entry. Original pending reviewer and null reviewedAt fields remain unchanged; no approval or canonical application was performed.

Independently inspected brochure-render.png against the raw2027PDF and full official HTML. Merged grade cells apply IFP60% and separate1+4 70% across all route rows. Advanced is18weeks/HSK2~3 or equivalent; Intensive is11weeks/HSK4 or above or equivalent. Both Humanities(Business and SocialScience) and Science/Engineering cost CNY13800 for18weeks and CNY8800 for11weeks; these are programme totals, not annual prices.

The official2027 Chinese-taught full-guide title explicitly supports teaching medium and foundation identity. Advanced starts February2027 with October1,2026-January15,2027 application window; Intensive starts April2027 with October1,2026-March12,2027 window. Registration day remains unknown. Exact18weeks/11weeks text is retained, with null numeric months.

Under24, good health, valid ordinary foreign passport, high-school/senior-secondary qualification or equivalent, and under18 guardian authorization are retained. Graduation applicants may use mock-examination transcripts. HSK native-Chinese exemption is conditional on XJTU approval. No invented HSK numerical score or age-reference date is added.

All nine source checklist items are preserved: ordinary foreign passport scan; original/notarized diploma; original/notarized academic and UniversityEntranceExamination transcripts with course scores; Chinese certificate and conditional exemption; signed headmaster/teacher letter plus email/phone; Chinese/English study plan>=600characters/words; full physical form with doctor signature/hospital seal; noncriminal certificate with expiration; supporting documents if any. Online-only submission and no paper applications retained. The apparent graduating-student/mock-transcript versus original-diploma/entrance-results timing tension is disclosed for confirmation, not silently resolved.

Ordinary application fee is CNY500, with CNY800 replacing it for the specified FiveCentralAsianCountries scholarship applicants. Only the application fee is described as non-refundable regardless of admission result. Payment opens after initial review; no unsupported tuition nonrefund rule appears.

These entries are ordinary IFP with60% average high-school grade. The separately described1+4 pathway requires70%, comprehensive undergraduate review/interview and successful foundation completion with HSK4-equivalent and qualifying CSCA report. Ordinary IFP bachelor application/review remains separate and no bachelor placement guarantee is made.

The full guide publishes the HTTP isso.xjtu.edu.cn/recruit/login route. A separate fresh TLS-verified HTTPS200 capture of the exact same official host/path with no redirects supports its secure-scheme display. This does not invent a new destination or establish any programme fact from the login page.

Every provided field quote across both entries was independently normalized and matched to its record-bound official capture; 30 field-evidence items checked. Numeric and date claims were additionally read in their full section/table context.
